pages.text: Every crop is of a $(thing)cultivar$() with its own traits: how fast it grows, how much it yields, and how well it stands drought and frost. Seed saved from a harvest keeps its cultivar, so you can select the best of your own fields. Now and then a trait mutates.
Crops that need $(thing)pollinators$() set more seed with flowers nearby and bees working them: keep flower strips and a hive near beans, sunflowers and other insect-pollinated crops.

A $(thing)Gene Splicer$() combines two seeds into a $(thing)Spliced Embryo$(), which grows into new seed in a $(thing)Genetic Incubator$(). Watch it: once in a while something else grows in there, breaks out and slimes about for a few blocks before it falls apart.
